summary: One-line fix extends the VLA-handling branch to also match the 'Q' (64-bit variable-length array descriptor) column format, which was previously only handled for 'P' (32-bit). Correct, minimal, and consistent with the existing branch logic; resolves the false-difference bug for Q-format VLAs.

issues.description: Substring test `"Q" in col.format` mirrors the existing `"P" in col.format` idiom, so it is consistent with the surrounding code, but both rely on the convention that Q/P appear only as VLA descriptor codes. Acceptable as-is since FITS format codes reserve Q exclusively for 64-bit VLAs; no change required.
